speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That is a snowy tree cricket. Oecanthus fultoni. I was done with Latin by fifth grade.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Okay, okay, tell you what. I am willing to bet anything that's an ordinary field cricket.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I've always found that an inappropriate slur. Chickens are not, by nature, at all timid. In fact, when I was young, my neighbour's chicken got loose and chased me up the big elm tree in front of our house.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Okay, I believe a chicken made you his bitch. But the cricket thing, I don't buy. Bet me.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Fair enough. What stake do you propose?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I will put up my Fantastic Four number 48, first appearance of Silver Surfer against your Flash 123, the classic Flash of two worlds issue.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right, you have a wager.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Great. Now how are you going to settle it, hmm? There is no way to determine the species of the cricket without examining it.
